source_title: Jio Platforms shares surge 28% since market debut
source_excerpt: New Delhi Shares of Jio Platforms, the Reliance Industries-backed digital services company, surged nearly 28% since making their market debut on Wednesday (October 28, 2026). The stock of the country's second most valuable firm by market capitalisation jumped 27.89% to ₹1,431.20 from the issue price of ₹1,119 on the BSE. Jio Platforms debuts at 21% premium as Sensex slides; valuation tops ₹12 lakh crore Jio Platforms debuts at 21% premium as Sensex slides; valuation tops ₹12 lakh crore With a market capitalisation of around ₹12.5 lakh crore, JPL overtook Bharti Airtel to become India’s second-most-valued listed company after parent Reliance Industries. Jio Platforms debuts at 21% premium as Sensex slides; valuation tops ₹12 lakh crore storyline 1 On the NSE, the stock gained 27.90% to ₹1,431.30 since its market debut. The company's market valuation has surged by ₹12,754.51 crore to ₹13,17,996.49 crore in three days. Jio Platforms is only behind Reliance Industries in the domestic market cap ranking. Reliance Industries has a market capitalisation (mcap) of ₹15,74,578.54 crore. The stock had listed at ₹1,358, registering a jump of 21.36% from the issue price, on both the BSE and NSE on Wednesday (October 28, 2026). Shares of Jio Platforms had ended nearly 27% higher against the issue price of ₹1,119 on the listing day. On Friday (October 30, 2026), the stock ended 0.57% higher at ₹1,431.20 on the BSE. It climbed 0.68% to end at ₹1,431.30 on the NSE.
